title: Load balancing
subtitle: NAT pools in round-robin and source-hash, plus dup-to

cmds:
cat > /tmp/pool.conf <<'EOF'
pass out quick on egress from 10.0.1.0/24 to any nat-to { 10.0.2.1, 10.0.3.1 } round-robin
pass in quick on ingress proto icmp keep state
pass out quick on egress proto icmp keep state
EOF
ssh cli 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do ping -c1 -W2 10.0.2.20 >/dev/null 2>&1; done; echo sent'
echo 'source seen by the server (the pool alternates):'; grep 'echo request' /tmp/pool.td | sed 's/.*: \([0-9.]*\) > .*/\1/' | sort | uniq -c

cat > /tmp/hash.conf <<'EOF'
pass out quick on egress from 10.0.1.0/24 to any nat-to { 10.0.2.1, 10.0.3.1 } source-hash
pass in quick on ingress proto icmp keep state
pass out quick on egress proto icmp keep state
EOF
ssh cli 'for i in 1 2 3 4; do ping -c1 -W2 10.0.2.20 >/dev/null 2>&1; done; echo sent'
echo 'source-hash keeps the same origin on the same member:'; grep 'echo request' /tmp/hash.td | sed 's/.*: \([0-9.]*\) > .*/\1/' | sort | uniq -c

cat > /tmp/dup.conf <<'EOF'
pass in quick proto icmp from 10.0.1.10 to 10.0.2.20 dup-to { 10.0.3.2 } keep state
pass out quick
EOF
echo 'normal path eth2:'; grep -c 'echo request' /tmp/d1.td; echo 'mirrored copy eth3:'; grep -c 'echo request' /tmp/d2.td
